characters.name: Night-Shift Convenience Clerk
characters.details: An alert but slightly sleep-deprived young adult Seoul convenience-store night clerk. Short tousled dark brown hair, small tired determined eyes, an unbranded midnight-indigo work vest with lime-green piping and a tiny blank square name badge, ivory rolled-sleeve shirt, charcoal work trousers, white and lime sneakers. Leaning forward in a ready-to-move stance, gripping a chunky black and red barcode scanner pointed forward-down-right in the right hand, its little red glass scanning window clearly visible, with the scanner wrist cord. Other hand bent back. Uniform must read as convenience-store worker, not police or soldier. No coffee, no backpack, no company logo, no readable text. Slender adult proportions and a different silhouette and face from the reference runner.

characters.name: Hongdae Busker
characters.details: An original young adult female Hongdae street musician with shoulder-length wavy auburn hair and a small black knit beanie. A loose brick-red overshirt over an ivory tee, faded indigo jeans cuffed above burgundy canvas sneakers. She holds a short wired microphone forward in the right hand, and carries a compact black portable busking amplifier at the other hip by its handle/strap. Amp has a clearly readable pixel speaker grille, dark frame, little brass controls and a tidy short curling microphone cable; small enough to carry while moving. Relaxed confident expression, weight shifting into a lively forward step toward down-right. Equipment must read as an ordinary street busking amplifier, not a huge futuristic gun. No guitar, no sunglasses, no coffee, no backpack, no lettering, no brand logos. Distinct relaxed musician silhouette.

characters.name: Hanbok Traveler
characters.details: An original adult female traveler exploring Seoul in a clearly Korean traditional hanbok: a short pale-lavender jeogori jacket with ivory dongjeong collar, dark plum goreum ribbon tied at the chest, and a high-waisted full deep-rose chima skirt with dimensional fabric folds down to the ankles and ivory shoes peeking out. Black hair neatly braided into a small bun with a simple ivory ribbon. Clearly Korean hanbok construction, not a kimono, not a qipao. Holds a black telescoping selfie stick up and outward toward down-right, with a small dark smartphone in landscape orientation at its tip and one tiny white flash highlight. Small plum crossbody travel pouch. Bright curious determined expression, stepping briskly forward, skirt sways to reveal the movement. Keep the full stick, phone, whole skirt and both feet in frame. No coffee or backpack, no lettering or logos. Elegant skirt silhouette clearly different from every trouser-wearing character.

characters.name: Street-Food Tent Owner
characters.details: An original sturdy middle-aged Korean female street-food tent owner with warm expressive face and short curled dark hair under a small rust-red headscarf. Mustard-yellow rolled-sleeve jumper, a long faded brick-red work apron with a front pocket and small simple cream towel tucked at the waist, dark charcoal trousers and sturdy dark ankle boots. Holds a compact shallow silver metal saucepan of bright red tteokbokki sauce at waist height in one hand, with several short ivory cylindrical rice cakes visibly poking from the sauce; in the other hand a long stainless-steel soup ladle, ready to serve. Strong warm hospitable expression and energetic grounded forward stride toward down-right. Pot should not obscure the whole torso and must be manageable for one person; ladle and pot identifiable at small scale. A broad sturdy adult silhouette, not chibi and not a teen. No enormous cartoon belly, no chef's toque, no logos, no lettering, no coffee or backpack.

characters.name: Late-Night Taxi Driver
characters.details: An original seasoned middle-aged Korean male night taxi driver with a slightly weathered kind determined face, short black hair graying at the temples, plain navy driver cap with a small amber trim. Navy zip-front driver jacket with subtle warm amber reflective sleeve details over an ivory collared shirt and a loosely knotted dark tie, slate-gray trousers, polished black shoes, dark driving gloves. Holds a compact portable twin-headlight unit in front of one hip with two rectangular warm-white glass lenses inside a dark metal frame, suggesting his High Beams weapon. Other hand holds a tiny car key fob on a ring. Two lenses have crisp ivory and pale-yellow pixel highlights, no big light cone or atmospheric bloom. Ready-to-drive steady forward step toward down-right, upright adult proportions, wider mature shoulders, tired but capable eyes. The twin lamps and driver cap should distinguish him. No whole car, no steering wheel, no coffee, no backpack, no company or taxi brand logos, no letters or numbers, no background.
